jobs.title: Sr. Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Senior Training Specialist**
==============================


**Location:** Carlisle, PA  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – up to 2 days per week remote  

**Travel:** 10–15%


**About the Role**
------------------



Are you passionate about creating learning experiences that make a real impact? We are looking for a **Senior Training Specialist** to join our team and help shape how employees learn, grow, and succeed across the organization.



In this senior\-level role, you will lead the **design, development, delivery, and continuous improvement of enterprise\-wide learning programs**, with a primary focus on building and owning a consistent, engaging onboarding experience for new employees across divisions and functions.



You will partner with leaders, subject matter experts, trainers, HR, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and develop learning solutions that support employee performance and organizational goals. This role offers the opportunity to influence learning strategy while remaining hands\-on in program development and delivery.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Enterprise Learning \& Onboarding**


* Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing management of an **enterprise\-wide onboarding program** that creates a consistent and engaging experience for new hires across all divisions and functions.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR teams to develop onboarding resources, coordinate learning activities, and facilitate new hire orientation programs.
* Analyze organizational and training needs to develop new programs or enhance existing learning solutions.
* Arrange and promote technical, professional, leadership, and other development opportunities across the organization.

### **Training Design \& Delivery**


* Design and develop training programs using a variety of delivery methods, including classroom training, e\-learning, virtual workshops, and on\-the\-job training.
* Lead classroom, virtual, and on\-the\-job training sessions, including coordinating schedules, logistics, materials, and participants.
* Develop engaging learning materials, including presentations, facilitator guides, participant guides, outlines, handouts, and other resources.
* Utilize e\-learning development tools, including **Articulate**, to create effective digital learning experiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts, trainers, and business stakeholders to ensure learning content is accurate, relevant, and aligned with business needs.
* Evaluate training materials and programs developed by other instructors and provide feedback to improve effectiveness.
* Conduct workshop observations for new instructors and provide coaching and feedback to support effective training delivery.

### **Business Partnership \& Consulting**


* Build strong relationships with leaders, hiring managers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions.
* Coach stakeholders to identify the right solution for their learning and development needs rather than defaulting to training as the answer.
* Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through data, feedback, and learner insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, learning solutions, and stakeholder partnership.

### **Vendor \& Program Management**


* Manage relationships with external training vendors, including **sourcing, contracting, coordinating, and evaluating vendor performance and quality**.
* Review and curate the **OpenSesame** content library to ensure course offerings remain current, relevant, and aligned with organizational and employee development needs.
* Coordinate external training programs, conferences, and professional development opportunities.
* Administer the **Education Assistance Program**, providing support and guidance to employees pursuing continuing education and professional certifications.

### **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**


* Identify opportunities to improve training programs, processes, delivery methods, and learner experiences.
* Use data, feedback, technology, and emerging learning practices to continuously improve learning solutions.
* Bring innovative thinking to the development and delivery of learning programs.
* Stay current on trends, technologies, and best practices in learning and development.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


### **Required Skills \& Abilities**


* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills with the ability to engage employees at all levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships and collaborate effectively with leaders, subject matter experts, trainers, and cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adaptable and comfortable working through changing priorities and organizational change.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to take ownership, act with urgency, and deliver solutions that support business needs.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on enhancing training effectiveness and learner experience.
* Innovative approach to developing learning solutions and using technology to enhance learning.
* Experience with e\-learning development tools such as **Articulate**.
* Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders across all levels of the organization.

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------


* **Bachelor's degree** required, preferably in Training \& Development, Education, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **7–10\+ years of experience** developing, delivering, and managing training programs for employees at all levels.
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading **enterprise\-wide learning, onboarding, or development initiatives**.
* Experience managing external training vendors and/or learning resources is preferred.
* Experience with e\-learning development and learning technologies is preferred.
* Experience supporting continuing education, professional certification, or employee development programs is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



In this role, success means creating learning experiences that are **consistent, engaging, relevant, and connected to the needs of the business**. You will help ensure new employees have a strong start, employees have opportunities to grow their skills, and leaders have the resources they need to develop their teams.



You will be successful when stakeholders see you not simply as someone who delivers training, but as a **trusted learning and development partner who understands the business and helps solve problems through effective learning solutions.**


**Working Conditions**
----------------------


* Primarily an office environment with hybrid flexibility of up to two remote days per week.
* Some exposure to the manufacturing environment.
* Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.
* Approximately 10–15% travel required.

**Join Our Team**
-----------------



If you're an experienced learning and development professional who enjoys **building programs from the ground up, partnering with leaders, developing people, and creating meaningful employee experiences**, we'd love to hear from you.



This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on how employees experience learning and development across the organization.

jobs.title: Project Lead - ELN/LIMS Implementation
jobs.description:
Project Manager / Business Analyst / Project Lead – ELN/LIMS Implementation (Life Sciences) About the Role
  
As a Project Manager / Business Analyst / Project Lead – ELN/LIMS Implementation , you will make an impact by leading the end\-to\-end implementation of Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) and Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) solutions within regulated laboratory environments. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Consulting team and work collaboratively with laboratory operations, Quality, Validation, IT, business stakeholders, vendors, and cross\-functional teams to deliver compliant, scalable, and business\-aligned laboratory informatics solutions.
  
In this role, you will serve as both a project lead and business analyst, driving requirements gathering, solution implementation, validation activities, and stakeholder alignment while ensuring compliance with industry regulations and quality standards. In This Role, You Will
  
Lead end\-to\-end ELN/LIMS implementation projects from planning, requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and post\-implementation support.
  
Partner with business stakeholders, laboratory teams, IT organizations, and vendors to gather, analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements.
  
Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, process maps, and implementation roadmaps while ensuring complete traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Support system configuration, customization, integrations, data migration, and adoption activities to ensure successful solution deployment.
  
Oversee validation activities including IQ/OQ/PQ, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, change control, and compliance documentation within regulated environments. Work Model
  
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States . Occasional travel may be required to client locations for workshops, project meetings, testing activities, training sessions, and implementation support.
  
Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Need to Have to Be Considered
  
Bachelor's degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
8\+ years of experience delivering Life Sciences, laboratory informatics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated industry technology projects.
  
Experience leading ELN and/or LIMS implementation projects within laboratory environments.
  
Hands\-on experience gathering business requirements, developing functional specifications, creating process maps, and managing stakeholder expectations.
  
Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, sample management, laboratory operations, and scientific data management processes.
  
Experience supporting system configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment activities.
  
Strong knowledge of GxP, GLP, cGMP, GAMP 5, CSV, and 21 CFR Part 11 regulations and compliance requirements.
  
Experience managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, validation activities, and project documentation.
  
Strong communication, leadership, facilitation, business analysis, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Experience working with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies. These Will Help You Stand Out
  
Hands\-on experience with Freezerworks ELN/LIMS implementations.
  
Experience implementing laboratory informatics platforms for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or quality control laboratories.
  
PMP, Agile, Scrum, CBAP, or related project management and business analysis certifications.
  
Experience managing vendor relationships and third\-party implementation partners.
  
Knowledge of laboratory instruments, laboratory automation systems, and scientific software integrations.
  
Experience supporting Computer System Validation (CSV) and regulatory inspection readiness activities.
  
Familiarity with cloud\-based laboratory informatics platforms and digital laboratory transformation initiatives.
  
Experience leading global or multi\-site laboratory system deployments.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. Salary and Other Compensation
  
The annual salary for this position is anticipated to be between $125,000 and $140,000 , depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, and other job\-related factors.
  
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans. Benefits
  
Cognizant offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our associates and their families, including:
  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  
401(k) plan and company contributions
  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  
Paid holidays and paid time off (PTO)
  
Paid parental leave and fertility assistance programs
  
Learning and development programs, certifications, and career advancement opportunities
  
Wellness and mental health resources
  
Career growth and internal mobility opportunities
  
Benefits may vary by location and employment status and are subject to change. Application Deadline
  
Applications will be accepted until September 30, 2026 .
  
Cognizant reserves the right to close this posting earlier based on application volume, business needs, or hiring timelines.
